title: I Will Sing to the Lord As Long As I Live

request.style: English, Byzantine Orthodox vesper psalm, a mixed choir singing over an ison drone, a bass cantor intoning each verse and the choir answering, no instruments, evening light, reverent, 66 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Bless the Lord, O my soul
O Lord my God, you are very great
You are clothed with honor and majesty
Wrapped in light as with a garment

[Chorus]
I will sing to the Lord as long as I live
I will praise my God while I have being

[Verse]
How many are your works, O Lord
In wisdom you have made them all
The earth is full of your creatures
Glory to you, O Lord

[Chorus]
I will sing to the Lord as long as I live
I will praise my God while I have being

[Outro]
Glory to you, O Lord, who made them all
